verdict.rationale: Terraform's policy enforcement docs say policies are rules for Terraform runs that check whether plans comply with security rules and best practices. Custom policies can be written in Terraform policy, Sentinel, or OPA, and enforcement results can be viewed and overridden in the workspace UI, which implies that failing checks gate the run before apply. Policies can also be published on the Registry. missing for 10: explicit documentation of hard-fail enforcement levels that block apply, enforcement only documented in HCP Terraform/Enterprise rather than the open-source CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
